study type: Prospective longitudinal survey, as part of a cluster randomized trial (OptiBIRTH)
outcome: Postnatal Health Related Quality of Life (HRQoL)
cohort: 862 women with one previous caesarean section from Germany, Ireland, and Italy
finding: Women who preferred VBAC but underwent ERCS had significantly lower postnatal HRQoL compared to those who preferred and achieved VBAC.
mod_finding: Women with a preference for vaginal birth who gave birth by elective repeat caesarean section had significantly lower HRQoL at three months postnatal.
